candidate_predicates.name: IS_PLAN
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly expresses one or more intended future actions, a next investigative step, or a strategy to be executed.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text expressing an intended future action or plan.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly identifies at least one intended future action or next step.
The expressed intention concerns what the agent will do rather than only reporting what has already been done.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports completed actions without expressing a future intention.
The reasoning is a final conclusion or summary with no intended next action.

candidate_predicates.name: TESTS_ASSUMPTION_WITH_TARGETED_INSPECTION
candidate_predicates.definition: A targeted inspection action is performed to resolve a specific uncertainty or assumption identified in reasoning, and the resulting observation provides information relevant to that uncertainty.

parameters.name: assumption_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the specific uncertainty, assumption, or missing information.

parameters.name: inspection_action
parameters.description: The action directed at inspecting the relevant artifact or data source to obtain information about the stated uncertainty.

parameters.name: inspection_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the result relevant to the uncertainty.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific uncertainty, assumption, or missing piece of information.
The action is directed at obtaining information that can address that uncertainty.
The observation contains information that can be interpreted as relevant to the stated uncertainty.
exclusion_conditions: No identifiable uncertainty or assumption motivates the action.
The action is unrelated to the stated uncertainty.
The observation does not address the uncertainty being investigated.

candidate_predicates.name: DERIVES_STORAGE_LOCATION_FROM_LAYOUT_METADATA
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning derives a concrete storage location for a target by applying address, offset, or layout mapping information contained in an observation.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that computes or derives the concrete storage location from layout metadata.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation supplying layout metadata such as section addresses, offsets, sizes, or mappings.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains identifiable address, offset, section, or layout mapping metadata.
The reasoning applies that metadata to compute a concrete storage location for the target.
The derived location is not merely a restatement of the observation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning mentions a section or location without computing a concrete storage location from metadata.
The observation lacks address, offset, section, or layout mapping information.
The derived location is unrelated to the observation.

parameters.description: The reasoning specifying the inferred transformation, key, terminator, or decoding procedure.

parameters.name: decoded_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the recovered or decoded payload.

The observation does not report recovered content or is unrelated to the transformation.
